method: Windows process-memory counters during one GNU Fortran O2 serialized Richards worker-population run; array payload computed from allocated extents; no physics or tolerance changes
scope: BASE-only 256-column, 32-node generated worker fixture, with each column executed in serial through fmr_execute_serialized_physical_column on one shared serialized Reference backend

workload.optional_physics: BASE; optional snow, soil temperature, Black, Boesten and drainage-response payloads inactive
workload.forcing_pattern: A-B-A cross-column identity case extended to 256 columns; the second forcing differs and remaining columns reuse the A pattern
workload.vertical_grid: generated uniform 0.05 m spacing over 32 nodes (1.6 m); controlled test fixture, not an official SWAP field profile
workload.execution: 256 direct serialized worker calls in deterministic input order; the public fmr_run_serialized_physical_multiswap dispatcher is not invoked

process_memory.accounting_note: Peak working set is the Windows process high-water counter. Private bytes are the maximum sampled PrivateUsage value and can miss a transient shorter than the 2 ms sampling interval. Process totals include runtime/code/fixed records and are not additive to the allocated-array payload totals.

claim_limitations: This measures the serialized worker seam and fully resident column inputs, not peak memory of the public batch dispatcher or production application bootstrap.
The generated uniform grid and homogeneous BASE workload are controlled test data, not an officially representative field workload.
This is a single O2 observation, not a cross-build or cross-hardware comparison; it makes no throughput, allocator-overhead, transient-private-memory or concurrency claim.

remaining_gap: Obtain an accepted representative workload and measure the public serialized batch dispatcher/production application end-to-end with optional-state composition and allocator/transient memory accounting. The present worker-level controlled BASE measurement is bounded scaling evidence only.
next_action: Reuse this memory counter method around the public serialized batch route on the narrowest already-admitted representative profile; if no accepted representative fixture is available, retain PARTIAL and proceed to M7-05 without inventing field representativeness.
